pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding allowed within 3 pips of an existing active entry; subsequent orders require a validated structural breakout confirmation and independent volatility-adjusted stop losses.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Strict ATR(14) expansion filter: forbid entries when current bar range exceeds 2.5x the 20-period moving average of ranges, eliminating high-impact news wick entries.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation once floating profit hits +$10.00 to guarantee minimum +$5.00 capture, preventing profit evaporation.
